sentence: This project studies how job exposures and genetic variants relate to the risk of shoulder replacement surgery caused by osteoarthritis.
This project studies what goes wrong in cells of the eye and cerebellum in a nerve disease, using mice to test ways to reverse it.
This project studies how repeated social defeat stress leads to lasting increases in alcohol drinking in males and females.
This project builds AI tools that combine clinical tests, brain scans and genetic information to improve diagnosis of psychosis.
This project tries to find out why people with anxiety drink alcohol to relieve negative feelings, and how treatment could target that.
This project studies how extreme weather affects the health of people in local settings and tests ways to reduce illness and death.
This project tries to find out how a host defense pathway that does not need interferon stops a herpesvirus from reactivating.
This project builds methods to study how genes are regulated in the developing human brain and how this relates to psychiatric disorders.
This project studies how the three-dimensional shape of the genome shapes the fate of T cells during long-lasting viral infection and tumors.
This project tries to find out whether balancing nucleotides helps heart muscle cells multiply and repair the heart after injury.
This project builds methods to rewrite regulatory DNA with CRISPR and uses computer models to predict how the edits change gene expression.
This project studies a regulator of immune cell metabolism to help T cells survive and work better inside the tumor environment.
This project tests ways to make effective cancer prevention and control interventions get used and last in community and health care settings.
This project tries to find out how a signaling protein drives triple-negative breast cancer to grow and spread through an enzyme that changes histones.
This project tries to find undiagnosed Alzheimer's disease in understudied groups by using disease trajectories and genetics.
This project studies whether new drugs that prevent graft-versus-host disease also help the body build immunity against cytomegalovirus after transplant.
This project studies the newborn pig heart to find out how heart muscle regenerates after a heart attack in large mammals.
This project builds small molecule inhibitors of a drug target protein to treat thrombosis in patients with blood disorders.
This project uses patient-derived organoids grown with immune cells to find out why a liver cancer resists current treatments.
This project tries to find out how diabetes changes dendritic cell activity and makes the gum disease periodontitis worse.
